description_en: Creates a live package channel group with a custom name and description
description_zh: 用于创建一个新的实时打包服务频道组，支持自定义名称与描述
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-live-package-channel-group --group-name channel-group-01 --client-token 000012e8864746a0a3980000 --description This_is_an_example_description. --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLivePackageChannelGroup

parameters.help_en: The channel group name. It can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (). The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length. Format: [A-Za-z0-9-]+
parameters.help_zh: 频道组名称，字符必须为大小写英文字母、数字、短横线、下划线。1 ~ 200个字符。格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The channel group description. It can be up to 1,000 characters in length
parameters.name: description
